value.rationale: The source poses an explicit noncircular pursuit-shape phenomenon without an analytical small-ellipse shape-response magnitude. The derived exact first-order phase third harmonic is a natural nontrivial measurable response, shows an unexpected nonmonotonic speed dependence and an optimal chase-speed ratio, and avoids arbitrary parameter slices. It can benchmark perturbation and trajectory phase-response calculations without falsely claiming a parametrization-free geometric obstruction.
